english:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to <solar/>Solar Weapons with one, two, or three mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead, equivalent to having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively.

source.text:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapons:

+20 | +40 | +50 Ammo Generation stat.

Swords receive +20 | +30 | +35 Ammo Capacity Stat.
Equivalent to Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, and Enduring Blade respectively.
